_comment: Above-the-fold eBay conversion strip, one entry per page. Consumed by tools/build-buy-strip.mjs, which writes the BUYSTRIP block into each page; enforced by site-auditor §15 (conversion-coverage). q = eBay _nkw for the strip's primary CTA; customid = EPN Custom ID so per-product earnings are readable in the EPN 'Performance by Custom ID' report. live=true shows the lowest live single-unit ask from /api/comps beside the product; it is only set where the primary query names ONE sealed product, because the cheapest listing on a broad player search is a $0.99 common and tells the reader nothing. Pages deliberately outside the contract are listed in the auditor's CONVERSION_EXEMPT set, not here. case = the sealed-CASE link rendered beside the box link (Idea #32, adopted 2026-09-20): a LINK ONLY — no figure is ever rendered from it, it never reaches the price engine and it is never an index input, because a case would corrupt a per-box mark. It is present only where tools/buy-strip-health.mjs measured at least CASE_MIN clean case listings (tools/case-shelf.mjs); `must` is a contiguous-phrase guard so a Bowman Chrome case link cannot land on a plain Bowman case (LANE-RULES R8). secondary.ag = true adds eBay's Authenticity Guarantee filter (LH_AV=1, read off eBay's own 'Show only' sidebar 2026-09-20) and routes the click to its own -ag custom ID, so the trust-copy effect is readable against the plain IDs. Set only where the link's own /api/comps median ask is >= $200 (eBay's Aug 2026 AG threshold for single cards) AND the AG-filtered search still has real depth — a narrow query plus AG is how you send a reader to an empty page. fanatics = optional {q,label,title}: a fanatics.com search link (Impact, subId1 = page slug) rendered beside the eBay CTAs (Sep 27 2026, Mo: restore the Fanatics links). Link only, never a price. rep = optional {q,label}: TEST 'rep the player' Fanatics gear search (subId1 <slug>-rep), Sep 27 2026.
